IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Government Operations & Elections (originally sponsored by Senator Honeyford)

Bill.BriefDescription: Designating "The Evergreen State" as the official nickname of the state of Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating a state nickname; and adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "The Evergreen State" is designated as the official nickname of thestate of Washington.
